jei.thaumaturgicconcilium.info.crimson_a: Found in dungeon, temple, mineshaft and stronghold chests.
jei.thaumaturgicconcilium.info.nether_me: Craft with any one item: dropped, that item no longer burns.
jei.thaumaturgicconcilium.info.polishmen: Stands for polishment in research pages: an infusion that needs it must be finished while you hold a Vis Conductor lock on a Destabilized Crystal of that aspect.
jei.thaumaturgicconcilium.info.primordia: Dropped by the Brightest One (coming in a later version).
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.annales_kn: You already know what the Annales say.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.annales_un: The script swims. You need the Crimson Rites first.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.bouillon.e: You slip into the Causal Bouillon
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.chort.has_: It's nice to deal with a business person, unlike some people...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.crimson_ra: Must wear a full Pontifex Robe to cast.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.crystal_mi: The crystal already holds another aspect.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.golem.taun: A golem chooses; a man obeys!
Now bow down and worship my wandcore!
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.bottl: He really brewed this thing? Gross. However...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.crims: Among the Pontifex's scrolls are pictograms of some old, primitive curses...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.desta: Only a fool will build that out of essentia itself, let alone activating it...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.impul: Genuinely a bad idea, but must be trivial to finish...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.mater: The Pontifex was not merely hiding beyond the rift. Something there peeled him out of the world...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.ponti: His hammer drank the life of everything near it. It could be made again...
His vestments kept him whole on the other side. They could be woven again...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.posit: Hm, Pechs should know more about organism alterations...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.refle: Hm, the only things missing are a method of experience exchanging and a brain contact scheme...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.runic: Horrific, you need to come up with more suitable ink for these runes...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.hint.vis_c: It seems that one must master both channelling and splitting Vis streams...
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.imp.pact: <%s> A fair gift. My kin will leave you be for a while.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.no_ring: The focus refuses you. Only a Ring of Blustering Light can bear this power.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.no_warp: There is no warp left in you to draw out.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.not_enough: Not enough vis in your wand
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.oblivion_r: You forget something... and %s comes to mind.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.polishment: The infusion needed polishment: %s %s through a Vis Conductor. The craft is lost.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.sloppy_alc: Eh? What am I doing here? Farewell...
I express my sincere gratitude to thee, please accept this...
My back... Take this, I'm going home...
Be gone the impkind... Take this, and don't repeat my mistakes.
message.thaumaturgicconcilium.thaumaturg: What would I want with that?
Why are you mooing? Can you even read?
You can talk when you've learned at least something.
Oh, lovely. They've sent me a mo-ron.
Maybe you can take a look?
I was thinking about that a lot lately.
Glad that finally got rid of it. My head can no longer endure that.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.alchemist: The Alchemist Spree effect splashes essentia over what it hits. Only works for the wearer of a Ring of Blustering Light.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.assistant: Rapid scientific progress requires sacrifices, but you are so tired of going down to the basement for them...

A fighting golem sent by this seal hunts the animals and monsters in its area, never players, pets or the young. Give it empty warded jars: a blow that would kill its quarry seals the creature in a stasis jar instead, badly crumpled.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.astral_mo: Weeks of mental convulsions did not pass without a trace: how are my friends now? Are they all right? A thaumometer that has touched the void could look through matter at the state of sentient beings.

Throw a thaumometer into a chained rift fed with 32 Sensus, 32 Vacuos and 16 Cognitio.
Sneak and use the monitor to place something tied to the person you want to watch in it: their xylographed wand fits just right. Holding the monitor shows their state.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.blood_bra: Blood alchemists crave compact and efficient tools, like the fast-flowing and short nature of life. This alchemically crowned bracelet can quench that thirst.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.bottle_of: A phial of water so clean it remembers being rain.
Thrown, the Bottle of Clear Water bursts into a spray that puts out burning creatures and fire blocks around where it lands. Blazes and magma cubes take 10 damage from it.
Bottled taint, boiled down until it clings.
Thrown, a Bottle of Thick Taint poisons every living, non-undead, untainted creature within 5 blocks with flux taint for 5 seconds and taints the ground around it with fibres, goo and flux gas.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.brightest:
If wisps are of the same nature as aura nodes, why are they different? You've spent a lot of time studying nodes, while a much more interesting subject has been looming in front of you and you haven't paid any attention. Maybe understanding the nature of "living magic" will give a clue to the unsolved problems of thaumaturgy, it's time to try to find out.
After careful planning - you are ready to conduct your first experiment: returning a living wisp to its original vis-reality.

You have everything you need ready - a tool to capture and redirect the wisps, as well as a stabilized output in the form of a rift.
The results of the experiment promise to be curious in each of your predicted cases.
Zap a Charged Wisp into a chained rift: when the rift closes, a Brightest One comes through. It cannot be hurt; drain its charge with Charged Wisps instead, and at none left it dies and leaves a piece of Primordial Life.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.burdening: An amulet that makes your enemies everyone's enemies.

Curios necklace. Every second, your tamed pets within 32 blocks turn on the creature you look at. While you carry temporary warp it burdens your sight (Death Gaze) and slowly bleeds that warp away. Warp Ward stops it. Needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.burned_wi:
Witch hunters are well prepared to fight those who practice black magic. Systematically capturing and bringing to justice those who have decided to take the wrong path, they usually do not care where the witches end up after that.
After all, villagers do not visit such places.
In the Nether the burned ones circle high above their prey on their brooms and rain brews down on it, the worst of them made for vampires and werewolves.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.cooling_f: The Cooling effect chills and slows what it hits. Its focus needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.crimson_a: A cultist's chronicle, bound in something that was not leather.
The Crimson Annales turn up in dungeon, temple, mineshaft and stronghold chests. Read one after learning the Crimson Rites to understand it.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.crimson_i:
Wearing the Pontifex's robe, you feel his mind control abilities filling you. Though you are not a member of the Cult, it seems the others don't think so, and are waiting for replenishment in the dwindling ranks.
You are quite capable of doing so. Wearing the full vestments of the Pontifex, touch with your Crimson Dagger one of the failed to handle the thaumaturgical knowledge, to give him a new chance at life.
A Crimson Blade serves as the dagger (or Tainted Magic's Crystal Dagger). Use it on a Mad Thaumaturge.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.crimson_p:
With a track record of successfully summoning a living creature from the other side of the rift, you think you know where the Pontifex of the Crimson Cult has disappeared to...
Of course, deliberately bringing someone clearly hostile out of oblivion is not the best idea, but you still need empirical data for your theory.
Rifts are known to resonate with items, so you need something connected to the missing person. A copy of Crimson Rites would be a good fit.

Throw the Crimson Rites into a chained rift. When it closes, a Lesser Crimson Portal opens in its place and calls the Cult; after its last wave the Pontifex himself steps through. He takes less harm for every cultist at his side, and the knowledge he carries is yours if you defeat him.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.crimson_r:
All of a sudden, out of nowhere.
With a weave of hand, the most powerful warriors of the Cult appear before you. While most summoners struggle with a couple of creatures - you have a whole army on demand.

Completing this research teaches the Crimson Raid spell component. Refer to the Arcane Compendium for details on casting. It opens a Lesser Crimson Portal where the spell lands, for 400 ticks, and only answers a caster in the full Pontifex Robe.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.crimson_s: Among the other scrolls that had been in the Pontifex's possession, you could find curious pictograms, apparently representing some kind of instructions. When you look closely, you realize that it's been a long time since you practiced this kind of magic...

True Primitive Curses: five symbols for a Witchery wand, learned when this research is complete. Each costs 200 infusion charge; your infusion shapes some of them.
Incarcerous: right, right, right, up, left, left, down.
Intrare Polosae: down, down, down, left.
Ariania Exumai: up, up, up, right, down, down, up, up.
Trup Ehsolvi: down, down, down, up, left, right, right.
Oculus Madesco: up, up, left, left, down, down, right, right.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.demateria: Sometimes the charge is better spent unmaking.
The Dematerialization effect spends drawn charge to undo what it touches.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.destabili: Nine crystals pressed into one that cannot decide what it is.

Place a Destabilized Crystal on any face. Use a vis crystal on it to give it that aspect, then keep feeding it crystals of the same aspect to raise its charge by one each. A Vis Conductor draws that charge out.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.drainage_: Void metal is known to drink life force. Does the drawn life force vanish, or does it stay in the metal, waiting to be drawn out again?

You reshaped void metal into a syringe joined to a small flask. Stab a creature within reach and hold: every two seconds it loses a tenth of its health and the syringe gains 10 vis, up to 100. Nothing can be drawn from a creature already halfway to death, and golems have no life to give. A player stabbed this way also loses vis from their wands.
Sneak and use to take the cap off; then hold use to pour the vis, 10 at a time, into a wand on your hotbar.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.dump_jack: Boots that build the ground you stand on.
Wear Dump Jackboots, hold a block and sneak: the boots place it under you and lift you up, one block every tenth of a second, until you let go of sneak or run out. Needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.ethereal_: The Ethereal Manipulator effect grips and moves what it holds at a distance. Its focus needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.flesh_cru:
Nothing lasts forever, not even your fatigue from this world. Besides, as it turns out, even the slightest interaction with the world, other than with your wand, has a negative effect on what's left of your body.
You rationally decided that you can always disappear for good at any time, so you needed a way to regain your wholeness.
You modified the crucible so that it could dissolve human flesh and keep it in a usable state for rubbing. Of course, the flesh has to come from somewhere, and the lunatics in your cellars won't think to object.
Mad Thaumaturges who wander in are rendered into flesh. Step in yourself to take back what you have lost. A redstone signal stops it; a comparator reads how full it is.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.gadomancy: Not so long ago, a capable thaumaturge harnessed the power of a singular amulet, tuning it to one aspect. His aura pylons still help thaumaturges, but their potential is not exhausted.

Fed the essentia of a sin, a pylon now spreads that sin around its base: Infernus smelts dropped items, Luxuria readies animals to breed again, Gula feeds players, Ira turns monsters on their neighbours, Invidia makes creatures drop what they hold, Desidia stretches every effect, and Superbia throws monsters away from the pylon.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.hex_of_pr: Today you found yourself at the bottom of this world, sprawled on bare stones, scratching runes into them. Whether it was a cosmic revelation or a lack of air at such a depth, you do not remember.

Ring a block of bedrock with eight blocks of ancient stone and strike the bedrock with your wand (1 Ordo and 1 Terra vis); strike it while sneaking and the hex is carved deep instead. Break a node and set a jarred node on the centre, then strike the jar: a young rift opens above, chained to the hex.
Vis condensers below the hex feed it essentia. A chained rift touches an item thrown into it with that essentia and remakes it (Chained Rift recipes). Anything else near the rift overloads it; too much heat and the rift collapses. Breaking any block of the hex undoes it.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.impulse_f: Compressed vis, let go all at once.
The Impulse effect throws a blast that bursts on impact. Infuse it onto a focus.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.infernal_: This heat-radiating bracelet is the sign of a lord of the Netherworld, though it was never clear whether the Netherworld or its emperor truly ruled.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.lithograp: Spending your time pulling out gadgets and staring at meters is clearly not your thing. This construction pierces a hole in your retina into the void, with a system of monitors as its lens.

Put the head of a bed on the floor, a block of thaumium on it and an advanced alchemical construct on top, with two blocks of gold stacked on either side of the thaumium, and strike the construct with your wand (1 Ignis, 1 Ordo, 0.5 Aqua and 1 Aer vis).
Load up to four monitors, set a vis condenser on the lithographer and a Sensus crystal holding 32 vis on that, lie down in the bed and power the machine. Coagulating Eye Drops close the hole again; another dose opens it.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.material_:
Your theory was confirmed, you found out where the leader of the Cult disappeared to, but how did he end up there? Though to tell the truth, you don't care anymore, the mysteries of the universe make your head hurt more and more every day, by the standards of a mortal man you have already achieved unprecedented things, maybe it's worth to... Have a rest? But how is it possible to do this when you are pestered by all sorts of evil, and demons of the mind are ready to jump out from around every corner?
Hmm, if the Pontifex came back from the other side relatively unharmed, maybe you can go there too? Now you know what he's got against you.

By placing a piece of Primordial Life back into the rift, you can attune it to interact with your flesh. Once you pass through it, you will become intangible to physical impact. However, using objects, swinging your fists at longtime enemies, or being fired upon by magic is fraught with the potential of unnecessarily dispelling that bit of matter that is still you. This negative effect does not threaten you if you use your wand, it has already become a full-fledged part of you, and remains the last safe emergency bridge to the material world.
Having weighed the pros and cons, you can finally go where you are unlikely to be reached from - deep beneath the bedrock of the earth.
Peace, at last.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.nether_me: A skin that grew in fire and kept the habit.
Craft a Nether Membrane with any one item to wrap it: dropped, that item no longer burns in fire or lava.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.polishmen: Some infusions come out rough. A last touch of the right aspect smooths them.

An infusion that needs polishment shows it in its research. When it finishes, the crafter must be within 16 blocks of the matrix, holding a Vis Conductor lock on a Destabilized Crystal of the right aspect with at least the charge asked for. The crystal is spent. Without that the craft is lost.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.pontifex_:
You were able to recreate the weapon of the legendary Crimson Pontifex. An impressive size, and an equally impressive ability to steal another's life.
Hold down the right mouse button to utilize this feature.

Years spent in a phantom state have affected not only the Pontifex, but also his vestments. You know it will not be very difficult to replicate it.
Wearing the full set allows you to forfeit your material wholeness at any time, at the cost of restricting your active freedom.
Press L to toggle this ability.
Despite the passage of time, fear of the Pontifex's mental power still permeates every member of the Cult. Wearing the full uniform, you feel confident in your ability to command the Crimson Warriors.

Throw each crimson cultist robe piece (or boots) into a chained rift whose Hex holds the essentia.
Your subordinates are empowered as they fight under a Pontifex skilled in the healing arts and insatiable for blood.
This robe can be dyed.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.positive_: Life given away in a ring.
The Positive Burst effect heals and strengthens those around its target. Infuse it onto a focus.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.primordia: Something brighter than a wisp left this behind. It is warm and will not stop moving.
Primordial Life is a reagent for the brightest devices of the thaumaturges.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.protobody:
Although your state of detachment from matter is inaccessible to most, you have realized how vulnerable it is.
After gazing into the Void for a long time, you were able to see yourself in it. Having cast aside the horrors of the mind, you came up with a different plan.
Having created an additional etheric body, you were unable to unite with it, and then, having thrown your copy into the Void, She rejected it, breaking it into pieces.

Having absorbed all the pieces separately, you can no longer be dispelled by a wave of the hand, and your wand is no longer the only way to contact with the world. You can use objects and attack without harming yourself.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.quicksilv: Every alchemist wishes to put his manufacturing on the stream. One of them, it seems, had a workplace accident: his new body of living quicksilver adapts to every attacker, and blows simply pass through it. Good thing metals melt well at high temperatures.

No one had ever found a way of merging essences. Then you threw one of those quicksilver losers into a boiling crucible, and its active body fused with the walls, taking up a more useful purpose.
Each piece of quicksilver thrown into the reactor is worth two Permutatio. Every second, while it is not powered by redstone, it spends one to fuse the last two essences of a crucible within eight blocks into their compound.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.reflectio: A mirror held up to a mind.
The Reflection effect turns harm back on its source. Its focus needs polishment.
Every way of travelling has its flaws. By learning to control the rifts and the potential of aura cores, you can form unstable passages into subspace.

Infuse an entropy aura core (Gadomancy) into an inert gem and wake it in a chained rift fed with 32 Motus, 32 Perditio, 32 Vitreus, 32 Vacuos and 16 Auram. Hold the gem and keep using it to pass a vis charge through it and open a short-lived rift; step in still holding it. Sneak and swing to flip the curvature of space. One step in the Bouillon is about ten at home. Do not lose the gem.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.rifts.sta: What I saw was frighteningly disgusting and incredibly beautiful at the same time. The very fabric of the universe had been torn apart by the distortion, creating a hole in space that led to... I don't know where yet. When I came too close it rejected me, injuring me. Outside, all I could see was a bottomless void.

Aura nodes are rifts too, only far more stable. That is easily changed by trying to break one: as it comes apart its structure loses its stability, and a spatial rift may open in its place.
A concentrated stream of Auram, such as the Dematerialization focus gives, closes a rift again; a Polishment Device deletes it outright.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.ring_of_b: A ring that pours light into the wands beside it.

Curios ring with 50 runic shielding. Every few ticks it adds a centivis of a random primal to a wand in your hotbar that has room. The Spotlight, Warp Extraction and Alchemist Spree effects only work for its wearer. Needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.runic_win: Paper inked thick with runes, wound tight around the body. It protects nothing; the runes do.
Runic Body and Legs Windings each hold 200 runic shielding and take back 5 every second, and each gives a 3% vis discount. As armour they are almost worthless.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.scribing_: Runes written in the air, on someone else.
The Scribing effect writes runic shielding onto its target. Its focus needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.shard_mil: Vis crystals ground fine do not settle like dust: each mote keeps a little of its aspect's temper.

Sneak-use the Greatwood Shard Mill to open its hopper. Open, hold use for a second to grind one primal vis crystal from your off hand (or else your inventory). Close it again and hold use to spray the powder. Each mote does its aspect's trick where it settles: aer calls lightning, ignis bursts into flame, aqua makes plants grow, terra lays dirt, ordo strikes the nearest creature and perditio withers.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.signal_fo: A focus that does nothing but shine, and is louder for it.
The Signal effect fires a bright flare. Infuse it onto a focus.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.silverwoo: Silverwood is patient enough to hold the darker crystals without splitting.

The Silverwood Shard Mill grinds Forbidden Magic's sins, flux and desire, as vis crystals or as sin shards. Ira sets creatures ablaze and saps them; invidia eats projectiles and spreads; vitium seeks out players and drains their wands when it touches them; superbia knocks back; luxuria wakes small taintacles; desidia slows; desiderium pulls things in; gula feeds whoever it touches.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.sloppy_al:
Heavy blood loss has an extremely negative effect on the cognitive abilities of Alchemists, and if this only affected their daily lives, it would be one thing, but many rituals require working with enormous amounts of vital energy.
Now all they can do is hope that someone will free them from their servitude.
In the Nether they crawl on all fours, ridden and driven by a spitting Chort. Kill the Chort and speak to the alchemist: it will thank you before it goes home.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.solid_voi:
You've discovered a curious use for your new ability - you can cause the void to gather at the end of your wand.
Simply get low enough and right click.
Below the bottom of the world, ethereal and whole (all six Protolimbs absorbed), right click with a wand: a block of Solid Void forms in your hand.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.spotlight: The Spotlight effect burns along a beam. Only works for the wearer of a Ring of Blustering Light. Its focus needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.taint_ani: The taint in a body can be told to stand up.
The Taint Animation effect raises taint from what it strikes. Its focus needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.tainted_b: Living in tainted lands by choice is strange in itself, but you would still like less direct contact with the corrosion. This compact bracelet should do the trick.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.terra_cas: Your escapes from subspace work because you have a home dimension. Can a rift be convinced to release you in another world?

Infuse an earth aura core (Gadomancy) into an inert gem and wake it in a chained rift fed with 32 Motus, 32 Perditio, 32 Vitreus, 32 Cognitio and 16 Auram. Hold it on a block holding Terra and it absorbs the block, binding itself to the dimension it was taken in. Combine it with a Gem of Rifts in a crafting grid to add the cast (up to 16); sneak and use the rift gem to pick one. Leaving the Bouillon, you arrive in the picked cast's world.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.thaumatur: Wisps answer a rhythm, if it is the right one.
Hold use to beat the Thaumaturge Drum. Every second and a half it calls a wisp of a random primal, as long as fewer than 16 are near.
Somewhere out there other thaumaturges walk the world, and they know things we do not. Their foci hum with tricks no book of ours describes.

This category gathers what can be pieced together of their craft: strange foci, the destabilized crystals they draw vis from, mills that grind crystals into living powder, and the trinkets they bind warp into. The thaumaturges themselves are not yet seen in this world; their lore will follow.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.thaumic_b:
Many thaumaturges wear hand jewelry that stores vis like a staff. Bracelets are an excellent substitute, but not every material that suits a wand will do for them. What if that is wrong?
A bracelet is staff-class: it spends a third less vis than its cap would on a wand, channels twice as fast, and its foci cool down in half the time.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.thaumic_h: At one time, a group of famous and very talented thaumaturges managed to invent a machine that allowed people to clone animals, modify them, and even cheat death itself. The healing vat has become an integral part of many people's lives, but I am sure that its potential has not been fully realized. I will surely find more uses for it, even if I have to go beyond the boundaries of ethics...
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.tight_bel: Buckled tight enough, the warp has nowhere to go but out.
Curios belt. While you carry temporary warp it presses on you (Thaumarhia) and now and then wrings one point of it out of you as flux gas over your head. Warp Ward stops it. Needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.valet_sea: After putting golems to work in your sawmills and alchemical factories, you decided to get one for more personal needs as well.

Put a named item in the seal's filter: its name is the password. When you say the password in chat within 32 blocks, a golem walks to the seal and uses what it carries on that block, as a use seal would. You will no longer have to turn on the lights yourself or open doors for guests.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.vis_conde: Accumulating, controlling and releasing titanic amounts of vis by hand is dangerous and tedious. Adapting the dematerialization of rifts to ordinary machines, you made a condenser that releases a vis charge the moment a redstone signal reaches it.

The charge flies away from the side the signal came from: the stronger the signal, the farther and the weaker the blast. A signal from below sends the charge straight up, into a Hex of Predictability above it. The condenser draws its vis from the destabilized crystal cluster on top of it, 16 parts a shot.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.vis_condu: A focus that drinks from a crystal rather than from the wand.

Hold the Vis Conductor on a Destabilized Crystal to lock on to it and draw its charge. While you hold that lock, a finished infusion that needs polishment takes its aspect from the crystal, and the crystal is used up. Released at a creature, the drawn charge strikes it.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.warp_extr: Warp drawn out like a splinter.
The Warp Extraction effect pulls warp out of its target. Only works for the wearer of a Ring of Blustering Light. Its focus needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.warped_dr: The aura already answers certain sounds. Many believe the mind is as complex as the world we inhabit; perhaps something useful can be got out of your own cranium.
Throw a Thaumaturge Drum into a chained rift fed with 32 Sensus, 32 Perditio, 16 Cognitio, 16 Bestia and 16 Vitium.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.warpwood_: Despite how small a vessel of vis a bracelet is, you contained the frightening power of the warpwood rod. You hope wearing such a dark thing so close will not greatly affect your health.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.witchwood: Those familiar with the arcane powers of man still need a backup plan in case their willpower runs dry. A witchwood bracelet fills that role like nothing else.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.wrath_att: The Wrath Attraction effect turns nearby creatures against its target. Its focus needs polishment.
research.thaumaturgicconcilium.xylograph: A simple and elegant way to sign your wand with your name. You can hand them out at your fan meetings!
Put a wand alone in a crafting grid to carve your name into it.
research.thaumichorizons.brain_littering: The ethical views of society have often become an obstacle to scientific discoveries and curious experiments. Unlike the blind crowd, you see one worthless soul as a small price for a breakthrough, so you rushed to experiment on whoever was near you at that moment.

People are quite resistant to mutation, and no intervention leaves the subject both sane and viable. But what if failure were the goal? They cannot fight back if they have nothing to do it with...
Infuse a Thaumaturge in an infusion vat with a curio of knowledge, two taint shards and a brain: what climbs out is a Mad Thaumaturge.
research.thaumichorizons.dope_squid.stag: Filling a pipe with your own hands is tedious. Squids spend their lives filtering water; surely they can do more.

Infuse a squid in the vat with two crystals and eight kinds of tobacco. Tame it with tobacco leaves and it swims after you through the air. Every twenty seconds, if you carry 10 temporary warp, it smokes 10 of it away for you with the tobacco you gave it (use a tobacco on it to choose). Use it with anything else to sit or wake it.
research.thaumichorizons.golem_bydlo.sta: Your human experiments have borne their first fruit! The idea of a thaumic golem the height of a mammoth has terrorized your mind for a long time, but such a mountain of thaum-metal cannot be woken by a crucible: it needs a powerful brain that will let it move and follow the simplest commands.

An ordinary zombie rotted away; a healthy man resisted too much. A Mad Thaumaturge was the compromise. Infuse one in the vat with three golems, golem powder, thaumium and tallow blocks and a golem fetter.

The golem cannot take a core, but it can carry you: use it to climb on and steer it. While riding, swing a wand whose focus breaks or mines blocks and the golem smashes the 5 by 5 square you look at, with the focus's fortune or silk touch; swing one with Wrath Attraction and it strikes everything around it. Left alone, it stays near where you left it.
research.thaumichorizons.red_powered_min: You have personally watched over every one of your manufactories for so long that you cannot remember when you last did anything else. Nobody inspires your trust, let alone golems. But what of a watcher incapable of disobedience?

Infuse a Mad Thaumaturge in the vat with buckets of liquid death, redstone blocks, a repeater, a comparator and a void seed. Freed into the open, it settles into a brain that reacts only to the redstone signal fed into it.
Bind a crystalline eye to the mind and set the eye into an astral monitor: a lithographer watching through it reads the mind's signal as its thoughts.
